rows.label: tlk43300241_01_msg0001
rows.name: Fons Maim is a capital of the arts.

rows.label: tlk43300241_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Even an unknown landscape painter like
me, painting scenery every day, is
respected here.

rows.label: tlk43300241_01_msg0003
rows.name:
My worries now are of a different
kind... You see, the distribution
center has sprung up in this square...

rows.label: tlk43300241_01_msg0004
rows.name:
It wasn't there when I'd
started painting the scene...

rows.label: tlk43300241_01_msg0005
rows.name:
Rumors that war with Superbia is near
are starting to feel very real.
